python3 -c "
# In obs_0034.png:
# Floor lamp base in foreground-left!
# Table in background!
# Let's inspect the floor lamp base contact in obs_0034:
from PIL import Image
import numpy as np

img = np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0034.png'))

# Base of floor lamp: around col 70 to 170, row 450 to 511
lamp_contacts = []
for c in range(70, 170):
    for r in range(511, 460, -1):
        # Base color is dark grey [50-90, 50-90, 60-100]
        if abs(int(img[r, c, 0]) - int(img[r, c, 1])) < 10 and img[r, c, 2] > img[r, c, 0] and img[r, c, 0] < 100:
            lamp_contacts.append((c, r))
            break

print('Lamp base points in obs_0034:', len(lamp_contacts))
if lamp_contacts:
    max_r = max(p[1] for p in lamp_contacts)
    print('Max row:', max_r)
    pts = [p for p in lamp_contacts if p[1] == max_r]
    print('Bottom pts count at max_r:', len(pts), 'cols:', [p[0] for p in pts])
    u_center = np.mean([p[0] for p in pts])
    print(f'u_center = {u_center:.2f}, v = {max_r}')
"
